title: ChartSpec

scale.description: A chart only: how values map to positions (default: linear).

suggestedMin.description: A chart only: the lowest the axis goes when the data doesn't reach it; a min overrides it.

suggestedMax.description: A chart only: the highest the axis goes when the data doesn't reach it; a max overrides it.

reverse.description: A chart only: run the axis the other way (largest first, or down for y).

scale.description: A chart only: how values map to positions (default: linear).

suggestedMin.description: A chart only: the lowest the axis goes when the data doesn't reach it; a min overrides it.

suggestedMax.description: A chart only: the highest the axis goes when the data doesn't reach it; a max overrides it.

reverse.description: A chart only: run the axis the other way (largest first, or down for y).

y2Axis.description: A second value axis, up the right side, for the series whose axis is right (they are measured on it, not on yAxis).

position.description: Which side of the chart it goes on (default: bottom).

orientation.description: Which way bars run (default: vertical); only when every series is bars.

stack.description: How series on the same axis are piled up (default: none). A series' own stack names the pile it joins, so bars can be stacked in groups. Bars, lines and areas stack; the rest don't.

startAngle.description: Where a pie, donut or polar area starts, in degrees clockwise from the top (default: 0).

sweep.description: How far round a pie, donut or polar area goes, in degrees (default: 360; 180 makes a half-circle gauge).

cutout.description: The share of a donut's radius left empty in the middle, from 0 to 0.95 (default: 0.55).

grid.description: Grid lines behind the data (default: on, except for pie and donut charts).

showPoints.description: A dot on every value of a line or area, where there is room for them (default: when no series has more than 40 values).

showStats.description: The min, max, average and count summary in the header (default: on).

bins.description: How many bars a histogram groups its values into (default: 10, at most 50).

color.description: The colour of the first series; the others follow the studio's palette (a CSS colour, e.g. #4ec9b0).

id.description: Names the series in click events.

kind.description: How this series is drawn when the chart mixes kinds (a combo): line, area, bar or scatter. Default: the chart's kind.

axis.description: Which value axis this series is measured on (default: left).

stack.description: The pile this series stacks in; series that share a name stack together. Default: one pile for all.

dash.description: A line or area only: solid, dashed or dotted (default: solid).

interpolation.description: A line or area only: straight segments, or a curve through the values (default: linear).

tension.description: A smooth line only: how round the curve is, from 0 (straight) to 1 (default: 0.4).

step.description: A line or area only: where it changes level between values, for a stepped line (default: none).

fill.description: A line only: fill down to the baseline. Default: on for an area, off for a line.

fillTo.description: A line or area only: fill the space between this series and the series at this index.

pointStyle.description: A line, area, scatter or bubble: the shape of each marker (default: circle).

pointRadius.description: The marker radius in pixels (default: 3.5 on a line, 4 on a scatter).

colorSegments.description: A line only: colors colour the segment that ends at each value instead of only its marker.

sizes.description: A bubble chart: each circle's radius in pixels.

from.description: A bar chart: where each bar starts (default: the baseline), for floating bars from from to y.

cornerRadius.description: A bar only: how round its outer corners are, in pixels.

colors.description: A colour for each value (a bar, point or slice); null keeps the series colour.

ids.description: Names each value in click events.

values.description: A histogram's samples: the studio counts them into bins.

items.description: One series of a chart, as columns. ChartSeriesSpec.Y holds the values; ChartSeriesSpec.X their positions (the index when left out); ChartSeriesSpec.Labels a name for each value (categories on the x axis, slice names in a pie). Every column given must be as long as ChartSeriesSpec.Y. A histogram's series has ChartSeriesSpec.Values instead: the samples to count.

width.description: The widest the visual is drawn, in pixels; it still fits narrower space. Left out, it takes the width there is.

height.description: The drawing's height in pixels, under the header. Left out, the studio picks one for the kind.

description: A 2D chart (application/vnd.fry.chart.v1+json): one or more series drawn as lines, areas, bars, points or slices. Series are columns of values, as in a Plotly trace; a missing value (null) is a gap.
